name: Markdown Preview
summary: Write Markdown and preview GitHub-flavored rendering live in your browser.
description: Edit Markdown on the left and see a live preview with GFM tables, task lists, strikethrough, and fenced code. Includes quick stats for words, headings, links, and code blocks.

faqs.question: Which Markdown flavor is used?
faqs.answer: GitHub-flavored Markdown via remark-gfm (tables, strikethrough, task lists, autolinks).

faqs.question: Is my draft uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Preview runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Can I export HTML?
faqs.answer: Yes — use the Markdown to HTML tool to convert source to HTML markup.
